brand.name: Mahindra
brand.tagline: Indian SUV maker; electric SUVs sold under the BE and XEV names
brand.description: Indian automaker founded in 1945, building utility vehicles and SUVs, with SUV plants in Chakan and Nashik, Maharashtra. Born-electric SUVs on the INGLO platform are sold under the BE and XEV names through mahindraelectricsuv.com.
